name: std::scoped_allocator_adaptor<OuterAlloc,InnerAlloc...>::deallocate

declarations.code: void deallocate(pointer p, size_type n) noexcept;

intro: Uses the outer allocator to deallocate the storage referenced by p, by calling std::allocator_traits<OuterAlloc>::deallocate(outer_allocator(), p, n).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
p

 -

 pointer to the previously allocated memory


 n

 -

 the number of objects for which the memory was allocated

examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
